crossRefs.note: Your teeth are like a newly shorn flock, which have come up from the washing, where every one of them has twins. None…
Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it, and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit…
Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

translations.web: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes, which have come up from the washing, of which every one has twins; not one is bereaved among them.
translations.bsb: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep coming up from the washing; each has its twin, and not one of them is lost.
translations.kjv: Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren
translations.asv: Thy teeth are like a flock of ewes, Which are come up from the washing; Whereof every one hath twins, And none is bereaved among them.
